# OIBSIP - Oasis Infobyte Java Development Internship

## About

This repository contains the projects completed during my Java Development Internship at Oasis Infobyte.

## Tasks Completed

### Task 1 - Online Reservation System

Features:

* User Login Authentication
* Ticket Reservation
* Ticket Cancellation
* Auto Generated PNR
* Seat Type Selection

### Task 2 - Number Guessing Game

Features:

* Difficulty Levels
* Score System
* Multiple Attempts
* Random Number Generation

### Task 3 - ATM Interface

Features:

* User Login
* Deposit Money
* Withdraw Money
* Fund Transfer
* Transaction History
* Change PIN
* Balance Inquiry

### Task 4 - Online Examination System

Features:

* User Login Authentication
* Password Update
* MCQ Based Examination
* Score Calculation
* Percentage Calculation
* Pass/Fail Result

## Technologies Used

* Java
* Object Oriented Programming
* Scanner Class
* Random Class
* ArrayList
